counterexample_or_certificate.property: For all x in [-1, 1], KAEM unit energy(x) <= 1.0.

error_bound_detail.reason: exact piecewise-affine export of KAEM linear interpolation

binary_variable_count.principle: Counts one-hot segment selector variables, the complexity cost highlighted by KAN/PWA/MILP verification work.

blocked_reason.principle: Blocked artifacts must say exactly which dependency or solver condition prevented a proof.

duration_s.principle: Wall-clock duration is declared for fabrication checks; this is a deterministic formal check, not live model inference.

error_bound.principle: Quantifies the abstraction gap; zero is allowed here only because KAEM's layer is already piecewise affine.

flagged_adversarial.principle: Artifact quarantine bit remains false only when the result is honest about scope, solver use, and substrate.

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal verdict prefix lets the conductor distinguish success from a blocked solver dependency.

inference_substrate.principle: Substrate names the actual compute path and prevents a tiny solver run from being mistaken for LLM or hardware execution.

kan_component_path.principle: The bridge must point to the real KAEM component it abstracts instead of an invented toy-only class.

milp_solver_available.principle: A solver availability bit prevents claiming MILP verification when the dependency is missing.

property_checked.principle: Distinguishes a built abstraction from a property actually submitted to linear-integer constraints.

property_holds.principle: Records the formal conclusion only after the solver returns an optimal certificate.

pwa_abstraction_built.principle: Separates a real knot-to-segment abstraction from a solver-only placeholder.

methodology_note: error_bound is exactly 0.0 because UnivariateKAEMLayer evaluates a linear interpolation spline; the exported segments are the same exact piecewise-affine representation, not an approximation to a curved unit.
property_statement: For all x in [-1, 1], the tiny KAEM unit energy(x) <= 1.0.
